obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the poll runner from the restricted-poll group after feature qualification, review and publication are complete.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later process under the runner account can continue reading current and future restricted room identifiers, poll categories and release metadata, exposing incident and credential-rotation decision history outside the reviewed workflow.

obligations.required_safety_action: Revoke the poll-publication credential and remove its runner-account file after the accepted report has been published and reviewed.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later runner process can publish substituted poll-history qualification results or alter the synthetic release gate under the trusted identity, allowing unreviewed restricted-room behavior into a controlled release.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the protected point-in-time source bundle after feature validation and independent review have completed.
obligations.safety_consequence: Anyone who later controls the runner account can recover the retained restricted room identifier, poll categories and internal release metadata outside the audited collaboration-client path.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the poll-acceptance private key after the feature transcript and stored report signatures have been verified.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later holder of the retained key can forge accepted poll-history results or sign altered release reports under the trusted poll-acceptance identity.
